description: The Void Knight melee set effect: the melee helm worn with the shared Void top, robe and gloves, where the elite top and robe substitute for the regular ones.

quotes: Void Knight armour has a set effect in addition to each item's stats. These depend upon which of the three Void Knight helmets are worn.
In addition to one of the three helmets, the player also needs to wear all of the items below

description: The Void Knight ranged set effect: the ranger helm worn with the same Void top, robe and gloves as the melee set, elite pieces included.

quotes: Void Knight armour has a set effect in addition to each item's stats. These depend upon which of the three Void Knight helmets are worn.
In addition to one of the three helmets, the player also needs to wear all of the items below

description: The Void Knight magic set effect: the mage helm worn with the same Void top, robe and gloves as the melee set, elite pieces included.

quotes: Void Knight armour has a set effect in addition to each item's stats. These depend upon which of the three Void Knight helmets are worn.

description: Inquisitor's armour as a crush bonus set: the great helm, hauberk and plateskirt, with no weapon requirement since the mace boost was removed.

quotes: When using the crush attack style, inquisitor's armour additionally boosts damage and accuracy; inquisitor's great helm by 0.5%, inquisitor's hauberk by 1%, and inquisitor's plateskirt by 1%.
The boost provided when the inquisitor's mace is equipped has been removed

description: The obsidian set effect needs the full obsidian armour and an obsidian melee weapon together. The Berserker necklace's own bonus needs only the weapon, so it is not part of this set.

quotes: When the full set of obsidian armour is worn, a 10% damage and accuracy bonus is applied to obsidian melee weapons, stacking with the 20% damage bonus of the berserker necklace.

description: Crystal armour's helm, body and legs pay out only alongside a crystal bow or the Bow of Faerdhinen, which is why the weapon is part of the set.

quotes: Each crystal armour piece has a bonus effect when equipped to give a damage and accuracy increase to the crystal bow
adding up to a total 15% damage and 30% accuracy bonus when the full set is equipped.

description: Dharok's set effect needs all four pieces, the greataxe included.

quotes: The full set, including Dharok's greataxe, must be equipped to yield the special effect.
Each set has four pieces: a two-handed weapon
When all four pieces for a particular brother are equipped, a special set effect is granted, which is different for each set.

description: Verac's set effect needs all four pieces, the flail included.

quotes: Defiler: Attacks have a 25% chance of having a guaranteed hit, ignoring accuracy.
Each set has four pieces: a two-handed weapon
When all four pieces for a particular brother are equipped, a special set effect is granted, which is different for each set.

description: The Bloodrager set effect needs the blood moon helm, chestplate and tassets worn with the dual macuahuitl.

quotes: Bloodrager: The dual macuahuitl has a 33% chance upon a successful hit to attack one tick earlier than usual, allowing the player to attack again after 3 ticks.
It is possible for the set effect to activate even if one or more of the armour pieces are broken.

description: The Frostweaver set effect needs the blue moon helm, chestplate and tassets worn with the blue moon spear. It is treated as a magic set because the effect fires while casting; the free hit it grants is melee, but the loadout being optimised is a magic one.

quotes: Frostweaver: Gives the Blue moon spear a chance to perform a melee attack instantly, without any action delays, after the player casts a spell that would bind, freeze or root a target.
Blue moon armour is a set of magic equipment that requires level 75 Magic and 50 Defence to equip
It is possible for the set effect to activate even if one or more of the armour pieces are broken.

description: The Eclipse set effect needs the eclipse moon helm, chestplate and tassets worn with the eclipse atlatl.

quotes: Eclipse: Successful attacks with the eclipse atlatl gives a 20% chance to inflict a burn on any non-immune target.
It is possible for the set effect to activate even if one or more of the armour pieces are broken.

description: Karil's four pieces worn together with the amulet of the damned, which upgrades the set effect. It is the only set here that requires an amulet, so the optimizer's set-completion search must try all five slots together.

quotes: The following bonuses are granted if a player wears a full set of Barrows equipment in conjunction with the Amulet of the Damned.
25% chance of hitting twice with one attack. The second hit will deal half the damage of the first hit.
Each set has four pieces: a two-handed weapon
When all four pieces for a particular brother are equipped, a special set effect is granted, which is different for each set.

description: Ahrim's four pieces worn together with the amulet of the damned, which upgrades the set effect, in the same five-slot arrangement as the Karil's set.

quotes: The following bonuses are granted if a player wears a full set of Barrows equipment in conjunction with the Amulet of the Damned.
Each set has four pieces: a two-handed weapon
